'''FC Gareji 1960''' ([[Georgian language|Georgian]]: საფეხბურთო კლუბი გარეჯი 1960), commonly referred to as Gareji, is a [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] [[Association football|football]] club from [[Sagarejo]]. Following the [[2025 Erovnuli Liga|2025 season]], they were relegated to the [[Erovnuli Liga 2]], the 2nd tier of [[Georgia (country)|Georgian football]].

The team first made headlines after achieving three consecutive promotions in 2018–20. In 2025, Gareji participated in the [[Erovnuli Liga|top flight]] for the first time in their history. 
 
The Central stadium located in Sagarejo is their home ground."}}
